remarks: Looking for room to build something special? This walkout estate lot in Southfort Estates offers 0.48 acres. of space with a west-facing pie shape that opens beautifully toward the rear. A treed pathway runs along the back fence, adding privacy and a natural buffer. All services are at the property line, and the setting places you within an established estate community close to Fort Saskatchewan amenities, including the Dow Centennial Centre, schools, and shopping. A standout opportunity to create your custom home in a premier neighbourhood. (id:67522)
